description: HEY THERE You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half. Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else. You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for. Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide! This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK. YOUR MISSION Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll: Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions YOUR PROFILE You'll feel at home here if: You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it Bonus points for: Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play) A strong statistics background Dagster or Airflow for scheduling Data catalogues like DataHub OUR CORE TECH STACK Here's what we run in production: Warehouse: Snowflake Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster Experimentation: GrowthBook Self-service analytics: Omni ML workflows: Prefect GenAI: Claude If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back. WHY US? An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back! A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, or ability, feels valued and empowered. Excited to take YAZIO to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! 36 or 40 hours per week

The team focuses on large-scale transformation, end-to-end process improvement, and designing scalable, future-ready solutions that support clients and investment teams. You will play an active role in a major, ongoing business and technology transformation, including: Designing, re-engineering, and documenting key business processes with business and IT stakeholders. Conducting requirements analysis and detailed gap assessments across a range of business areas. Writing test cases and organising and supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Supporting project management activities, including organising workshops with subject matter experts, overseeing IT delivery, preparing status reports, and supporting resource and work planning. Defining and presenting conceptual approaches, target operating models, solution options, and required decisions, both verbally and in writing. Working closely with IT counterparts to bridge the gap between business and technology teams. Training business users on newly implemented tools and supporting adoption and the wider change management process. We are looking for individuals who: Are curious and intellectually engaged, with a genuine interest in understanding complex and evolving business models. Naturally ask “why?”, challenge assumptions, and seek to understand root causes rather than symptoms. Are comfortable constructively challenging the status quo. Have a strong desire and ability to learn quickly, particularly when entering new or unfamiliar domains. Take ownership of solutions and are committed to delivering high-quality outcomes. Enjoy working collaboratively with a wide range of stakeholders. Requirements: University degree or equivalent experience in Business Economics, Business Informatics, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Initial professional experience in business analysis, ideally within financial services or a leading consulting organisation, in a hands-on role at the interface between business and IT. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multiple stakeholders and delivering to agreed deadlines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand business and technical functions and process information quickly. Confidence in constructively challenging existing processes and identifying opportunities to improve outcomes. Strong team-working and stakeholder-management skills across different levels of an organisation. Excellent written and verbal English communication and presentation skills. Ideal profile: This opportunity would suit an early-career Business Analyst who is interested in financial services, technology-enabled transformation, process improvement, and working at the intersection of business and IT.

Together, we’ll enable the future — starting with yours. description:
Wij zijn Vandebron

Onze reis begon in 2014 met Hoofdstuk 1 van de energietransitie, waarin we de markt transparanter wilden maken door consumenten rechtstreeks te verbinden met lokale, groene energieproducenten.

Nu, in Hoofdstuk 2, zetten wij ons in om 100% groene energie, 100% van de tijd beschikbaar te maken. Denk aan slimme oplossingen - flexibel gebruik van wind- en zonneparken, slim opladen van elektrische voertuigen en efficiënte energieopslag.

We wachten niet af en leveren een actieve bijdrage aan een duurzame toekomst met zo nu en dan een vleugje rebellie.

Groene energie, slimme oplossingen - dat is Vandebron.

Hier kom jij terecht

Samen met je teamgenoten ben je verantwoordelijk voor het beheer en de optimalisatie van onze energieportfolio. Dit gaat van langetermijnhedging tot kortetermijnoptimalisatie op de day-ahead, intraday en ex-post markten, én het optimaal inzetten van al onze flexibele assets (zoals batterijen) over de verschillende relevante markten.

Je werkt nauw samen met het Forecasting team om aanbod en vraag in de portfolio perfect in balans te houden, en met Account Management voor de langetermijncontracten met onze producenten. Hierbij houd je de risico's en kosten van onze tradingactiviteiten scherp onder controle. Jouw werk bepaalt direct hoe Vandebron waarde creëert in de energiemarkt en helpt ons om 100% groene energie 100% van de tijd beschikbaar te maken.

Wat ga je doen?
Je verhandelt stroom en gas over alle relevante markten, van langetermijnhedging tot dagelijkse trading op de day-ahead, intraday en ex-post markten.
Je vertaalt productie- en consumptievoorspellingen naar slimme tradingbeslissingen die het portfolio in balans houden en risico's beperken.
Je zet onze flexibele assets, waaronder batterijen, zo slim mogelijk in om maximale waarde uit de verschillende markten te halen.
Je ondersteunt Account Management bij het bepalen van de waarde van langetermijncontracten met onze energieproducenten.
Je bouwt mee aan de verdere automatisering van onze tradingsstrategieën en tilt onze huidige aanpak naar een hoger niveau.
Je zet portfolio- en tradinginzichten om in heldere prijsmodellen en rapportages voor interne belanghebbenden.

Zo maak jij het verschil
Je beschikt over een WO werk- en denkniveau in een kwantitatieve, technische of economische/bedrijfskundige richting.
Je hebt ervaring met programmeren (bijvoorbeeld in Python en SQL) en bent bedreven in data-analyse en kwantitatieve modellering.
Je hebt een sterke affiniteit met financiële of tradingconcepten, zoals risicomanagement en hedging. Ervaring met of affiniteit met de energiemarkt is een grote pre.
Je bent proactief en ondernemend. Je wacht niet af tot taken worden toegewezen, maar pakt de regie en gaat af op de kansen en risico's die jij ziet.
Je graaft graag diep door als er iets afwijkt of opvalt; je onderzoekt zaken liever zelf grondig in plaats van er alleen over te rapporteren.
Je communiceert helder, kunt ingewikkelde materie eenvoudig uitleggen aan diverse teams en durft jezelf te laten horen.
Je werkt nauwkeurig, behoudt het overzicht en maakt op drukke momenten snel de juiste keuzes.

Wat wij jou bieden
Een salaris afhankelijk van je werkervaring, tussen de €3.000 en €3.700 bruto per maand, op basis van 40 uur, exclusief vakantiegeld.
Een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van de prestaties van het bedrijf
30 vakantiedagen per jaar
Extra betaald verlof voor bijzondere momenten, zoals een verhuizing, bruiloft en uitgebreid ouderschapsverlof. Daarnaast ben je ieder jaar vrij op Bevrijdingsdag én krijg je nog 2 extra vrije dagen: één voor vrijwilligerswerk en één wanneer je kiest voor duurzaam reizen
Tot 6 weken per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken (maximaal 4 weken aaneengesloten, waarvan maximaal 4 weken buiten de EU)
De mogelijkheid om na 3 jaar een sabbatical op te nemen
€1.200 opleidingsbudget per jaar + onbeperkt toegang tot onze L&D-programma's
Veel aandacht voor je welzijn, met onbeperkte toegang tot het mentale gezondheidsplatform OpenUp
Een pensioenregeling
Inkomensbescherming via een verzekering voor langdurige arbeidsongeschiktheid
€50 netto per maand als vergoeding voor je telefoon en wifi
Eenmalig €200 budget voor het inrichten van je thuiswerkplek
Korting op je Vandebron-factuur
Flexibel hybride werken vanuit huis en ons CO₂-neutrale kantoor in Amsterdam
Iedere dag een gratis, gezonde en vegetarische lunch, vers bereid op kantoor
Een NS Business Card als je op 10 km of meer van ons kantoor woont

Interesse?

Enthousiast geworden over deze rol? Solliciteer direct via deze pagina.

Nog niet helemaal overtuigd of heb je vragen? Neem gerust contact op via jordreukers@vandebron.nl.

Bij Vandebron geloven we in diversiteit, inclusie en gelijke kansen. We nodigen je uit om helemaal jezelf te zijn — het is voor ons geen enkel probleem als je jouw geslacht of geboortedatum niet op je cv vermeldt. We gaan zorgvuldig om met je privacy. Volgens de AVG/GDPR ben je niet verplicht om informatie te delen over je gezondheid, ras/nationaliteit of religie, en mag je jouw BSN en pasfoto gerust weglaten uit je sollicitatie.

description: Responsibilities The Product Owner is accountable for maximizing the business value delivered by the product. This includes owning the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and backlog, and shaping business priorities across product-enabled processes. The role focuses on the "why", "what" and "when" of the product — value outcomes, user experience, and prioritization — while partnering with product administrators, developers, and integration teams on the "how" of solution delivery. The Product Owner also ensures appropriate approval and governance of product changes based on risk, compliance, and business impact. Key Responsibilities Own Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmap Define and communicate the product vision, goals, and success measures (e.g., data accuracy and integrity, error rates, automation levels, cycle times, user adoption). Align product strategy with business objectives, operating model, and technology standards. Maintain and socialize a multi-year product roadmap, including sequencing, dependencies, and expected value outcomes. Backlog & Pipeline Ownership Own, prioritize, and continuously refine the product backlog/pipeline to maximize value, balancing regulatory/compliance needs, risk reduction, technical health, and business outcomes. Ensure backlog items are well-defined (scope, dependencies, non-functional requirements where relevant, and acceptance criteria) and transparent to stakeholders and delivery teams. Define and maintain working agreements (e.g., Definition of Ready, Definition of Done), including UAT approach and sign-off criteria. Translate Business Needs into Functional Solutions Lead discovery with business stakeholders to understand pain points, define desired outcomes, and translate needs into user stories / functional requirements with measurable acceptance criteria. Drive functional solution decisions (e.g., configure vs. customize vs. integrate) in partnership with technical SMEs, optimizing for speed, operational efficiency, maintainability, security/auditability, and total cost of ownership. Own functional standards for the product (e.g., common ways of working, master data rules) and manage exceptions through agreed governance. Partner with Product Admins, Developers & Integration Teams Collaborate closely with product administrators, developers, integration teams, and vendors to deliver changes (configuration, scripting, reporting, integrations, etc.). Review technical solution designs to ensure alignment to business intent and standards. Coordinate UAT and functional sign-off; confirm release readiness, including training, communications, support handover, and documentation. Drive Data Integrity & Process Consistency (Business Ownership) Define and maintain business rules, controls, and process standards to drive consistency across subsidiaries/business units and prevent one-off decisions that reduce scalability and reporting integrity. Partner with process owners to drive the process changes needed to fully leverage product capabilities, improve productivity, and reduce operational and control risks. Partner with administrators to ensure role-based access, segregation of duties, and validations that will enable clean operations and compliant reporting. Own or co-own master data standards (e.g., customers, vendors, items, chart of accounts) and champion data quality practices with business/process owners. Data, Architecture & User Experience (UX) Stewardship Champion a user-centric approach to product decisions, ensuring that workflows, interfaces, and content are intuitive, accessible, and aligned to how end users actually work. Define and maintain UX guidelines and patterns for the product (e.g., navigation standards, form layouts, error messaging, terminology) in partnership with design and technical teams. Leverage qualitative and quantitative data (e.g., usage analytics, funnel/drop-off analysis, CSAT/NPS, support tickets, time-on-task) to identify pain points and opportunities to simplify and streamline the user experience. Establish and manage feedback loops with end users (e.g., interviews, surveys, usability testing, beta programs, office hours) and translate insights into clear product requirements and backlog items. Define, track, and report experience-focused KPIs (e.g., task completion rates, user adoption, time to complete key flows, error/rework rates) and incorporate findings into roadmap and prioritization decisions. Partner with data and analytics lead to align product data models, integrations, and reporting structures with target-state data architecture and reference architectures. Define and maintain conceptual and logical data views for the product (e.g., key entities, relationships, and flows) to support scalable integrations, analytics, and downstream systems. Ensure that data captured through the product (e.g., required fields, validation rules, defaults, and reference data) balances user effort with downstream needs for reporting, analytics, and controls. Own or contribute to data management practices for the product, including data lifecycle rules (creation, updates, retention, archival), data ownership, and stewardship responsibilities across business teams. Partner with data, analytics, and reporting teams to align on metric definitions, critical data elements, and master/transactional data usage, ensuring data is fit for purpose and enabling self-service insights where possible. Support compliance with data-related policies (e.g., privacy, retention, protection, segregation of data) by ensuring product features, configurations, and processes reflect required controls. Stakeholder Management & Governance Identify, engage, and manage stakeholders to align priorities, manage expectations, and secure required sponsorship and sign-offs. Act as the primary point of contact and decision facilitator for product demand, providing clear rationale for prioritization decisions. Establish and operate governance practices (intake, prioritization forums, approval thresholds, release cadence, and change control) to ensure a stable, transparent, and auditable change pipeline. Oversee user enablement (training materials, communications, office hours) to drive adoption and effective use of the product. Release, Testing, and Change Management Plan releases with delivery teams; coordinate UAT; publish release notes; and drive training and adoption for product changes and vendor updates. Provide post-release hypercare, triage issues, and prioritize fixes and enhancements. Track and report outcomes after go-live (e.g., adoption, time savings, defect trends, control effectiveness, user feedback) and feed insights into backlog prioritization and roadmap refinement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. 3 - 5 years of relevant experience in product ownership, business analysis, project management, or process improvement. Demonstrated experience managing product roadmaps and backlogs and delivering cross-functional system or process changes. Experience working with business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and governance forums. Experience with Agile or hybrid delivery methods. Experience with NetSuite is advantageous. Skills Product strategy, roadmap development, and value-based prioritization. Business analysis, requirements elicitation, user story development, acceptance criteria definition and process re-engineering. Backlog management, release planning, UAT coordination, and change management. Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation, negotiation, and decision-making skills. Ability to translate business needs into practical functional solutions in collaboration with technical teams. Analytical and problem-solving capability, including the use of data and user insights to guide decisions. Working knowledge of data governance, internal controls, access management, system integrations, and user experience principles. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to present complex issues to business and technical audiences. Other Information We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

DeltaQuad is growing internationally, and we're building a dedicated Product Management department to drive our product roadmap and specifications.

As a Product Manager, you'll connect complex hardware and software capabilities with market needs, define new product releases, and help deliver innovative solutions to defense, security, and government customers worldwide.

Do you have a strong technical background, experience with hardware/software integration, and a passion for product management? We'd love to meet you!

The role

Reporting to the Lead Product Manager, you'll join our newly established Product Management department and help shape DeltaQuad's product strategy, roadmap, and specifications.

You'll define product releases, manage complex hardware and software integrations, and work closely with cross-functional teams to turn market needs into reliable, high-impact product capabilities.

Your responsibilities:

Manage Product configurations & lifecycles: Define and maintain a database of product baselines, track variant configurations, and manage changes across hardware and software lifecycles to ensure end-to-end traceability and consistency.

Define release scope & requirements: Scope new product releases and translate market needs into clear, actionable technical specifications and requirements.

Lead system integrations: Drive product specifications for hardware and software integrations, including payloads, communication technologies, and positioning/navigation systems.

Build product knowledge: Expand and maintain DeltaQuad's internal product knowledge base, ensuring product capabilities and specifications are well-documented, organized, and easily accessible.

Drive internal communication: Actively inform departments across the organization about the product portfolio, new capabilities, and upcoming releases.

Serve as product SME: Act as the internal Subject Matter Expert (go-to person) for product-related questions regarding variants, capabilities, specifications, and performance.

Monitor market trends: Continuously analyze market developments, competitor moves, and emerging technologies within the autonomous systems, UAV, and defense sectors.

Shape PM practices: Contribute to defining and maturing the practices, frameworks, and methodologies of DeltaQuad's newly formed Product Management department.

What we're looking for

We are looking for a Product Manager who combines a strong technical foundation with a disciplined approach to hardware/software product management.

You'll likely bring:

A university degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Aerospace, or a related technical discipline.

At least 5 years of experience in a Product Management role within a high-tech or complex technology environment.

Proven experience managing mixed hardware/software products (e.g., robotics, aerospace, defense, autonomous systems, IoT, or complex mechatronics). Please note: this role is not suitable for software-only product managers.

Deep understanding of core Product Management methodologies, lifecycle management, configuration management and roadmap development.

Demonstrated track record with system-level integrations (e.g., payloads, sensor suites, radio/communication networks, or positioning technologies).

A highly structured and organized way of working.

Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to bridge business, operational, and engineering perspectives.

Why join DeltaQuad?

Join a fast-growing international technology company where you'll help shape our Product Management discipline and influence the future of autonomous drone technology. You'll work with passionate colleagues on innovative products that make a real-world impact.

What we offer:

A competitive salary and employment package.

27 days of annual leave based on a full-time contract.

An excellent pension scheme through the PME Pension Fund.

The opportunity to build and lead a function with real strategic impact.

Excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.

Daily lunch provided by DeltaQuad.

Monthly team drinks and regular team activities.
